pages.text: TYPE_ERROR stands for the type ERROR: an error report.$(br2)An error has four elements: $(1)code$(), $(1)message$(), $(1)context$() (the function) and $(1)line$(). Code 0 means no error. Your own error codes must be 1000 or higher.
Craft a type base and a campfire together.
$(1)VARIABLE problem ERROR$(br)CALL fail problem$(br)ASSIGN code problem.code ;$()
The CALL catches the error of $(1)fail$() in $(1)problem$().
